_meta.why: Generated once, human-reviewed, committed. A dunning email for a given failure code is the same class of output every time, so paying for inference on every invoice would be waste. Runtime fills the slots; no model is called on this path.
_meta.review: Edit this file directly and re-run the suite. Changes are code review, not prompt engineering.
_meta.business_slot: The sender is the CLIENT's business, not PayPilot. PayPilot is the tool; the recipient is the client's customer and has never heard of us. Set PAYPILOT_BUSINESS_NAME.
_meta.canary_note: Ownership fingerprint. Do not remove. See scripts/canary.py. A copy of this string outside github.com/IvanSFlowGit/paypilot is an unlicensed copy.

diagnosis.card_expired: The card on file for {name} has expired, so the {plan} renewal couldn't be charged. This is the most recoverable kind of failure: the subscription is active and only needs a current card, so retrying the old one will keep failing until it's updated.
diagnosis.insufficient_funds: The latest {plan} charge for {name} was declined for insufficient funds, which is almost always a temporary timing issue rather than a churn signal. The card itself is valid, so spacing the retry to land after a likely top-up should recover the payment.
diagnosis.generic_decline: The {plan} payment for {name} hit a generic decline, meaning the issuer blocked it without a specific reason - often a temporary bank hold. It's a recoverable middle case: one well-timed retry plus a nudge to check with their bank usually clears it.
diagnosis.issuer_do_not_retry: The bank behind {name}'s card has declined it in a way that retrying will not fix, so the {plan} payment will not go through on this card however the retry is timed. Retries stop until a new payment method is added, so the only route to recovery is asking for a different card or payment method.
diagnosis.card_details_invalid: The card data on file for {name}'s {plan} payment doesn't match: the number, expiry date, security code or billing address is wrong, so retrying the same details will fail the same way. The customer only needs to correct the card details.
diagnosis.direct_debit_not_retried: The direct debit for {name}'s {plan} payment didn't go through, and Stripe does not retry this kind of payment automatically. Nothing will re-attempt it on its own, so the customer needs to pay through the invoice or set up the debit again.
diagnosis.retries_exhausted: Every scheduled retry of {name}'s {plan} payment has now failed, so nothing will re-attempt it on its own. The customer needs to add a new card or payment method for the subscription to continue.

subject.card_expired: Your card on file has expired
subject.insufficient_funds: We could not process your latest payment
subject.generic_decline: A quick issue with your latest payment
subject.issuer_do_not_retry: Your latest payment needs a different card
subject.direct_debit_not_retried: Your direct debit didn't go through
subject.retries_exhausted: Your subscription payment needs a new card

fallback.diagnosis: The {plan} payment for {name} failed for an unrecognised reason. Treat it as recoverable: retry once and invite the customer to verify their payment method.
fallback.subject: A quick issue with your latest payment
